# TanStack Query downstream suite

[TanStack Query](https://github.com/TanStack/query)'s React adapter tests (`react-query`, `react-query-persist-client`, `react-query-devtools`; Vitest, 26 files), unmodified, on jsdom and on @ctrl/dom.

## Run

```sh
pnpm downstream:tanstack-query --install     # first run: clone the pinned commit and install its dependencies
pnpm downstream:tanstack-query --preset all  # what the results below track
```

Presets: `smoke` and `all` (what the results track).
